Welcome to my homepage.

I will be a research assistant at the University of Cologne starting September 2026. I will work under the supervision of Prof. George Marinescu and Prof. Alexander Drewitz in the framework of the DFG funded project Random Polynomials and Random Kähler Geometry.

I received my PhD from Université Paris Cité in 2026 under the supervision of Prof. Xiaonan Ma.
